title: A single-location user still sees the filter with one selectable location and unchanged behavior
permissions_required: Reports/Performance access; a user with access to exactly one location.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in as a user assigned to exactly one location.
steps: 1. Open the report and open the location filter.
expected: 1. The filter is still shown, with one selectable location.
2. Report behavior is unchanged from single-location use.
